jobs.description_snippet: **This is a software development job.** You'll design, build, test, debug, deploy and maintain real systems. What's different is how the code gets written. We use agentic coding tools as a default, so a lot of implementation gets drafted by an agent working under your direction. Your time shifts toward specifying precisely, reviewing carefully, and verifying rigorously. The bottleneck moves from typing code to judging it. Day to day you'll be building [product / systems] in [stack]. Normal engineering work, at unusual throughput. We want developers, full stop. If you can't read a stack trace and reason your way to the cause, these tools won't cover for you - they'll just help you produce bugs faster. If your experience is mostly using AI tools without a developers background, this isn't the right role for you. **What you'll do** * Break work into pieces an agent can execute and you can verify * Review a high volume of generated code and catch the plausible-but-wrong * Debug systems you didn't write line by line * Build the guardrails that make speed safe: tests, types, linting, CI * Own what ships. "The agent wrote it" isn't a defence * Bring back what you learn about where the tools break **What we need** * **Real software fundamentals** - data structures, APIs, databases, and the ability to reason about correctness, performance and failure modes * **Debugging ability.** You can find the cause, not just the symptom * **Strong code review instincts.** The highest-leverage skill on this team * **Git, CI/CD and command-line comfort** * **Testing discipline** - you don't trust code you haven't verified * **Clear writing.** Vague instructions produce vague software * **Honesty about uncertainty.** "I don't understand this yet" is a feature **By level** * **Junior:** solid fundamentals and evidence you build things. Portfolio, personal projects or coursework is fine - we'll teach the workflow. * **Mid:** 3+ years shipping production code, and you've already worked this way on something real. * **Senior:** you can design systems, set standards for how the team works with agents, and mentor people through the shift. **Bonus points** * Hands-on experience with Claude Code or similar agentic tools * **Print industry experience** - prepress, PDF/PostScript workflows, colour management, variable data printing, web-to-print, or print MIS * Familiarity with MCP or tool integrations * Open-source contributions Pay: R10 000,00 - R30 000,00 per month Work Location: In person

jobs.description_snippet: **OVERVIEW:** Trade Ocean is a Southern African maritime and logistics group established in 2007. We specialise in Customs Clearing, Freight Forwarding and Ships Agency services, operating across six branches from Cape Town to Walvis Bay, connecting clients to a global network. Our culture is built on a simple but powerful foundation: taking ownership, and we are always looking for people who do the same. As Junior Data Analyst in Business Improvement at Trade Ocean Shared Services in Cape Town, you will report to the Process and Data Lead on a nine-month fixed-term contract. You will own the hands-on work of finding data quality problems, cleansing and reformatting records, and enriching datasets so that they conform to agreed master data standards. This is a high-volume execution role rather than a modelling, dashboarding or data science one, so expect long stretches in Excel, Power Query and SQL, working through large and often messy datasets with care. You will also need to be comfortable approaching busy operational and finance managers to secure the missing data and approvals you need to finish the job. jobs.blurb: Junior Data Analyst focused on data quality, cleansing, and master data standardization for a maritime logistics group. High-volume execution role working with large datasets in Excel and SQL.

jobs.description_snippet: **Introduction** Metropolitan is one of the oldest financial services brands in South Africa. With a 127-year legacy of serving the communities in which it operates, Metropolitan represents true empowerment in serving Africa's people through affordable financial solutions that create financial growth and security. jobs.blurb: 12-month learnership programme with MetLife for unemployed youth starting October 2026, focused on financial services and customer engagement.

jobs.title: ABAP Developer
jobs.must_have_skills: REST APIs, Testing/Debugging, Code Review, SAP
jobs.description_snippet: **Purpose** The ABAP Developer is responsible for the design, development, testing, documentation and support of custom developments and enhancements within the TNPA SAP environment, in accordance with agreed standards and the defined project scope. The role delivers reliable, high-quality technical solutions that meet TNPA’s business needs across its port operations. The incumbent works from functional specifications provided by Business Analysts and functional consultants to build, unit-test and hand over developments, and provides peer review and support to the broader SAP team. **Responsibilities** * Design, develop, test and document custom ABAP developments and enhancements from approved functional specifications. * Develop reports (classical / ALV), interfaces, conversions, enhancements, forms (SAPscript / Smart Forms / Adobe Forms) and workflows (the RICEFW objects). * Develop and consume integration objects – BAPIs, RFCs, IDocs, Proxies, OData / RESTful services – in support of SAP integration requirements. * Apply modern SAP development techniques where relevant (Core Data Services (CDS) views, ABAP on HANA optimisation, Fiori / UI5 enhancements for S/4HANA). * Perform unit testing and provide peer-review testing to other developers; support functional, integration and user-acceptance testing and defect resolution. * Ensure that all developments adhere to SAP and TNPA coding, naming, performance and security standards. * Create and maintain the technical documentation associated with each development. * Manage developments through the transport landscape in conjunction with the SAP Basis team. * Provide development support, enhancements and bug-fixes to the production environment as required. * Ensure that system-governance requirements are met and accept that auditing and / or health checks on developments may be done at random at any time. **Position Challenges** * Delivering performant custom code in a HANA-optimised landscape while maintaining backward compatibility. * Balancing new development against production support and defect resolution. * Meeting delivery timelines while adhering to coding, performance and security standards. **Decision Making** * Determine the technical design and construction approach for each development within agreed standards. * Recommend enhancement techniques and reusable components. * Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and code-quality issues. **Qualifications and Experience** * Bachelor’s degree / National Diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related discipline. * SAP ABAP certification is advantageous. * 3–5 years’ SAP ABAP development experience. * Experience with ABAP on HANA, CDS views and / or SAP Fiori / UI5 is a strong advantage. **Skills Required** * Strong ABAP / ABAP OO development skills, including reports, interfaces, conversions, enhancements, forms and workflow (RICEFW). * Experience with BAPIs, RFCs, IDocs, Proxies, Enhancement Framework, BAdIs, User Exits
jobs.blurb: ABAP Developer designing and developing custom solutions within SAP environment for port operations. Responsible for development, testing, documentation and support of enhancements.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance (SAP Test Analyst)
jobs.must_have_skills: Test Cases & Test Plans, Defect Tracking
jobs.nice_to_have_skills: Agile/Jira, Test Cases & Test Plans, Performance Testing
jobs.description_snippet: **Purpose** The Quality Assurance (QA) Analyst is responsible for planning, designing and executing testing across the TNPA SAP landscape to ensure that configured and developed solutions meet business, functional and technical requirements before release. The role safeguards the quality and integrity of SAP changes delivered into the production environment in support of TNPA’s operations. The incumbent embeds quality-assurance disciplines across the SAP delivery lifecycle, manages the defect lifecycle, and provides objective assurance to the project and support teams and to management. **Responsibilities** * Develop test strategies, test plans and detailed test cases / scripts aligned to business and functional requirements across the relevant SAP modules. * Execute functional, integration, regression, data-migration and performance testing, and coordinate and support user-acceptance testing (UAT). * Establish and maintain test data and test environments in conjunction with the SAP Basis team. * Log, track, prioritise and manage defects to closure, and report on test progress, coverage and quality metrics. * Validate that transports and changes meet defined entry / exit (quality-gate) criteria before promotion through the landscape. * Support and, where appropriate, introduce test-management and automation tooling (e.g. SAP Solution Manager Test Suite, HP ALM / equivalent). * Verify adherence of deliverables to TNPA quality standards and provide sign-off recommendations. * Contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes, standards and templates within the SAP team. * Liaise with Business Analysts, developers, functional consultants and the Project Manager on quality matters, keeping stakeholders informed of risks and issues. **Position Challenges** * Ensuring adequate test coverage across integrated SAP modules within compressed delivery timelines. * Securing representative test data and stable test environments for reliable results. * Maintaining regression coverage as the landscape evolves through upgrades and enhancements. **Decision Making** * Determine the testing approach, scope and prioritisation for each change or release. * Assess defect severity and provide quality-gate / release-readiness recommendations. * Recommend acceptance or rejection of deliverables against defined quality criteria. **Qualifications and Experience** * Bachelor’s degree / National Diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related discipline. * Software-testing certification (e.g. ISTQB) is advantageous. * 5 years’ software quality-assurance / testing experience, including experience testing SAP solutions. * Knowledge of both waterfall and agile testing methodologies. **Skills Required** * Strong knowledge of test planning, test-case design and defect management. * Experience with test-management tools (e.g. SAP Solution Manager Test Suite, HP ALM or equivalent). * Understanding of SAP business processes and cross-module integration. * Excelle
jobs.blurb: QA analyst responsible for planning, designing and executing comprehensive testing across the TNPA SAP landscape. Ensures configured and developed solutions meet business and technical requirements before production release.
